title: Principal Recruiter
description:
We are seeking a remote, full-time Principal Recruiter based in Latin America with 5+ years of experience in full-cycle recruiting and proven leadership capabilities. In this role, you will lead and develop a team of recruiters while owning end-to-end talent delivery strategy and execution across multiple roles.


You will partner closely with Sourcing, Client Success, and leadership to deliver high-quality talent, improve recruiting performance, and scale talent operations. This is a hands-on leadership role that combines execution, strategy, and team development.



Responsibilities



Lead & Develop the Recruiting Team

  • Lead, coach, and develop a team of recruiters
  • Set clear performance expectations and talent quality standards
  • Provide structured feedback, training, and mentorship
  • Foster a high-performance, accountable, and collaborative team culture
  • Conduct regular 1:1s and support career growth of team members


Own Full-Cycle Recruiting Execution

  • Manage end-to-end recruiting processes from intake to offer
  • Screen, interview, and evaluate candidates for technical and non-technical roles
  • Ensure a high-quality candidate experience throughout the process
  • Partner with sourcing to ensure strong pipeline conversion
  • Oversee offer process and ensure smooth handoff to onboarding

Drive Recruiting Strategy & Client Partnership

  • Lead role intake and align on requirements with stakeholders
  • Translate business needs into structured recruiting strategies
  • Partner with Client Success and Resource Managers to meet talent delivery goals
  • Anticipate challenges and adjust strategies proactively
  • Ensure alignment between client expectations and recruiting execution


Elevate Candidate Evaluation & Talent Quality

  • Define and refine candidate assessment frameworks
  • Implement and oversee technical testing and evaluation processes
  • Ensure consistent and objective candidate selection across roles
  • Maintain high standards for candidate quality and role fit


Drive Operational Excellence

  • Improve recruiting workflows, processes, and documentation
  • Ensure consistency, speed, and quality across talent pipelines
  • Identify bottlenecks and implement process improvements
  • Manage referral programs and internal recruiting initiatives


Leverage Data & Continuous Improvement

  • Track and analyze recruiting metrics (e.g., time to fill, conversion rates)
  • Use data to improve talent delivery outcomes and team performance
  • Identify trends and opportunities for optimization
  • Continuously improve recruiting strategies, tools, and practices



Required Experience



  • Excellent written and verbal English communication skills
  • 5+ years of experience in full-cycle recruiting and at least 3+ in a leadership position
  • Experience leading or mentoring recruiters
  • Strong interviewing and candidate evaluation skills
  • Experience managing multiple roles and stakeholders simultaneously
  • Ability to translate business needs into effective talent strategies
  • Familiarity with ATS platforms and recruiting tools
  • Strong organizational skills and attention to detail
  • Ability to operate in a fast-paced, high-growth environment
  • Demonstrated ability to work independently and collaboratively


Desired Experience



  • Experience recruiting for technical roles
  • Experience working with North American clients or companies
  • Experience in agency, consulting, or nearshore/offshore recruiting environments
  • Exposure to recruiting analytics, reporting, or process optimization
  • Experience in growth-stage or startup environments


Additional Information



  • Knowing your ideas are heard and matter, think big!
  • You get to own your job and be recognized for your contributions
  • Work with smart and creative people
  • Making mistakes is human. Let’s learn from them. Be transparent!

title: Tracking & Digital Analytics Engineer (Web, Mobile & CTV/OTT)
description:
Role: Tracking & Digital Analytics Engineer (Web, Mobile & CTV/OTT)

Location: Brazil (Remote)

Contract


Role Overview:

We are looking for a Tracking & Digital Analytics Engineer to support analytics and tracking implementation across web, mobile (iOS/Android), and CTV/OTT platforms for a large-scale streaming product. This is a hands-on implementation and QA-focused role.


The engineer will work closely with Product, Engineering, QA, and Analytics teams to ensure accurate data capture, validation, and measurement across digital platforms.


Key Responsibilities:

  • Translate business and product requirements into clear tracking specifications
  • Implement and validate analytics tracking across Web, iOS, Android, and CTV/OTT platforms
  • Perform data validation, QA checks, and event verification
  • Troubleshoot tracking issues and data discrepancies
  • Validate third-party measurement tools such as Nielsen and comScore
  • Maintain tracking documentation and support release readiness


Required Skills & Experience:

  • Strong experience with digital analytics tracking implementation
  • Hands-on experience with Adobe Analytics
  • Experience with Tealium or similar tag management tools (Adobe Launch, GTM, etc.)
  • Strong background in analytics QA, validation, and debugging
  • Experience working in fast-paced, cross-functional environments


Platforms:

  • Web applications
  • Mobile apps (iOS & Android)
  • OTT / CTV platforms
  • Streaming / digital media products



Apply today or share profiles

title: Electrical BIM Specialist – Vendor Track (Work, Learn & Transition to Staff)
description:
⚡ Learn. Work. Get Hired.

Get Paid to Level Up Your Electrical BIM Career

Looking for your next step in Electrical BIM?

This is not your typical job.

It’s a paid opportunity to learn, work, and prove yourself.

Join ENG and:

  • Work on real projects
  • Learn from top professionals
  • Get paid while you grow

You’ll start working with us in a vendor-based model , gaining real experience and exposure.

Bonus points

  • U.S. project experience
  • Knowledge of NEC standards


Why join

  • Paid from day one
  • Real projects (no fake training cases)
  • Fast learning curve
  • Clear path to becoming part of the team


Apply now. Limited spots available.

title: Lead Generation Specialist
description:
The pay for this role will be between USD 693 to 850/month, depending on experience.


About Us

Publicity For Good (PFG) is a US-based, female-founded public relations agency that partners with impact-driven, heart-centered leaders and purpose-driven CPG brands (Food & Beverage, Fashion, and Beauty). We are an all-female team dedicated to amplifying brands that make a difference through meaningful visibility and measurable growth. We operate in a fun, fast-paced environment where collaboration creates magic.


Role

This position is responsible for generating and nurturing qualified leads with the primary objective of booking sales calls. The Lead Generation Specialist will manage inbound and outbound lead channels, validate prospect interest, coordinate with the sales team, and maintain an organized pipeline across multiple platforms.


As a Lead Generation Specialist , you will monitor and respond to leads from various sources including Meta ads, Leadhype, Smartlead, and GoHighLevel (GHL). You will conduct call show audits, manage follow-up sequences, update pipeline statuses, and ensure seamless handoff of qualified prospects to the sales team. This role requires strong communication skills, exceptional organization, and the ability to work independently across multiple systems while maintaining high response rates and booking quality.


Responsibilities

  • Monitor and respond to new leads across all platforms (GHL, Leadhype, Smartlead, Meta ads).
  • Conduct daily call show audits and update show/no-show statuses in tracking systems.
  • Manage and update the Airtable Lead Gen dashboard with accurate lead data and metrics.
  • Qualify inbound leads and schedule sales calls with interested prospects.
  • Execute manual follow-ups for warm leads and re-engagement campaigns.
  • Review and respond to positive replies from Leadhype and Smartlead outreach campaigns.
  • Update lead tags, statuses, and ownership in GHL based on prospect engagement and stage.
  • Maintain accurate pipeline management and ensure all conversations are properly categorized.
  • Coordinate reschedules for no-show prospects and maintain consistent follow-up cadence.
  • Process and segment new Meta ads leads into appropriate workflows.
  • Review notes from sales reps in GHL and take necessary follow-up actions.
  • Update sales team on lead status changes, show/no-show patterns, and booking confirmations.
  • Track daily lead generation metrics including new conversations, responses, and bookings.
  • Identify and flag low-quality leads or technical issues with lead sources.

title: SAP Business Data Migration Expert - Manufacturing
description:
For one of our international clients, RED Global is looking for an experienced SAP Business Data Migration Consultant with expertise in Manufacturing and Procurement processes to support a global S/4 Hana template rollout.


This is a remote role with occasional travel to Brazil, will focus on managing data migration activities in the Manufacturing and Procurement areas, ensuring data readiness, cleansing, and integration across multiple systems to support a seamless deployment.


Key Responsibilities:

  • Manage business data migration activities, aligning with the Client’s deployment plan and milestones.
  • Coordinate and complete Manufacturing data cleansing tasks, meeting deadlines and quality standards.
  • Create and manage master data lists for assigned Commercial and Procurement objects.
  • Provide business insights to support data extraction and conversion from legacy systems.
  • Ensure Manufacturing data readiness throughout the migration lifecycle, including quality checks, validation, and defect remediation.
  • Verify data is suitable for intended Manufacturing processes, aligning with relevant stakeholders.


Desired Skills:

  • Minimum of 8+ years' experience in data migration and ERP implementations (S/4HANA)
  • Proven experience in SAP data migration, including data cleansing, mapping, and validation.
  • Strong understanding of Manufacturing, Commercial, and Procurement processes.
  • Experience in working with master data objects, including creation, management, and migration.
  • Experience in multi-country/global ERP deployment projects.
  • Strong stakeholder management and communication skills.
  • Advanced Microsoft Excel skills for data analysis and reconciliation.


Details:

Start date: ASAP

Duration: 6 month + Possible extension

Location : Remote + Occasional travel

Rate: USD / day

Language: English + Spanish or Portuguese


If you are interested in receiving further information about the role, please send me your updated CV at

title: Media Arts Teacher – IB MYP (Secondary School)
description:
Join Our Team as a Media Arts Teacher – IB MYP (Secondary School) at St. Nicholas Pinheiros!


We are seeking a dynamic and innovative Media Arts Teacher to join our Arts team, teaching as a member of the Secondary School team at our Pinheiros campus . Media Arts engages students with a range of digital media forms—including video, animation, and audio production—to develop their creativity, critical thinking, and communication skills. The course emphasises investigating, creating, and reflecting on media, and understanding how media communicates ideas, emotions, and cultural perspectives.


The successful candidate will actively contribute to interdisciplinary learning across the MYP, collaborating with colleagues to strengthen connections between Media Arts and other subject groups. The role also includes supporting the Personal Project, leading a tutor group and providing pastoral support to students, and contributing to the life of the school through clubs and activities.


Core Responsibilities


  • Teach Media Arts across the MYP.
  • Guide students through projects involving video production, animation, sound design, and digital storytelling.
  • Foster creativity, critical thinking, and reflective practice in students.
  • Maintain an inclusive, safe, and engaging learning environment.
  • Collaborate with colleagues to plan and deliver Arts and Interdisciplinary learning.
  • Support broader school initiatives and community projects as required.


Qualifications


  • A teaching degree in Media Arts, Digital Arts, Film, Animation, Visual Arts, or a related field.
  • Demonstrated experience with video editing, animation tools, and audio production software.
  • Strong communication skills and effective classroom management.


What We Offer:


  • Brazilian CLT work contract;
  • Comprehensive medical and dental plans for your well-being;
  • Life insurance coverage;
  • Delicious meals with lunch provided at our restaurant;
  • Up to three paid days off per year as per our personal day policy.


**Please note that occasional Saturday work may be required to support school programs.**


Join us in creating a nurturing and enriching environment where every child thrives.

Apply now and be a part of the St. Nicholas' family! We look forward to welcoming you to our team!


Our school is dedicated to safeguarding and promoting the welfare of all students. We prioritise creating a safe, supportive, and inclusive environment. All applicants will undergo comprehensive background checks to ensure the highest standards of safety and care for our community.

Media Arts engages students with a range of digital media forms—including video, animation, and audio production—to develop their creativity, critical thinking, and communication skills. The course emphasises investigating, creating, and reflecting on media, and understanding how media communicates ideas, emotions, and cultural perspectives.


The successful candidate will actively contribute to interdisciplinary learning across the MYP, collaborating with colleagues to strengthen connections between Media Arts and other subject groups. The role also includes supporting the Personal Project, leading a tutor group and providing pastoral support to students, and contributing to the life of the school through clubs and activities.


Core Responsibilities


  • Teach Media Arts across the MYP.
  • Guide students through projects involving video production, animation, sound design, and digital storytelling.
  • Foster creativity, critical thinking, and reflective practice in students.
  • Maintain an inclusive, safe, and engaging learning environment.
  • Collaborate with colleagues to plan and deliver Arts and Interdisciplinary learning.
  • Support broader school initiatives and community projects as required.


Qualifications


  • A teaching degree in Media Arts, Digital Arts, Film, Animation, Visual Arts, or a related field.
  • Demonstrated experience with video editing, animation tools, and audio production software.
  • Strong communication skills and effective classroom management.


What We Offer:


  • Brazilian CLT work contract;
  • Comprehensive medical and dental plans for your well-being;
  • Life insurance coverage;
  • Delicious meals with lunch provided at our restaurant;
  • Up to three paid days off per year as per our personal day policy.


**Please note that occasional Saturday work may be required to support school programs.**


Join us in creating a nurturing and enriching environment where every child thrives.

Apply now and be a part of the St. Nicholas' family! We look forward to welcoming you to our team!


Our school is dedicated to safeguarding and promoting the welfare of all students. We prioritise creating a safe, supportive, and inclusive environment. All applicants will undergo comprehensive background checks to ensure the highest standards of safety and care for our community.

title: Product Owner
description:
Company Description

Metrobi is a fulfillment platform designed to support local businesses, particularly in industries like food and beverage. The company simplifies delivery management by connecting businesses with local contractor drivers and optimizing in-house delivery operations. Through its logistics, financial, and marketing tools, Metrobi empowers local businesses to confidently grow their distribution networks. Metrobi operates with a mission to enhance efficiency and scale for local makers and distributors.


Intro video:


Responsibilities

  • Backlog & Kanban Management:

Own the Kanban board: organize tasks, ensure priorities are clear and understand what is stopping us from maintaining our task flow to hit our deployment goals. Communicate risks, issues, blockers, and quality concerns to the PM and relevant team members.

  • Task Definition & Refinement:

Review and write descriptions for tasks about new features, improvements and bug fixes. Ensure problems are well explained and solutions are testable and aligned with product goals. Collaborate with the Product Manager to translate strategy into actionable tasks.

  • Validate Outcomes, Not Just Output:

After new features or fixes go live, verify whether they truly solved the original problem and improved the targeted user or business metrics.


Qualifications

  • Strong skills in Product Management and Business Analysis to define and evaluate product requirements effectively.
  • Excellent Communication skills for collaborating with cross-functional teams and stakeholders.
  • Familiarity with Software Development processes and tools to coordinate effectively with technical teams.
  • Ability to adapt in a dynamic, fast-paced working environment and manage multiple priorities.
  • Prior experience in a similar role is preferred.
  • Skills like SQL, Git, reading Python code and doing data analysis are very beneficial, but not required


Notes

  • This is a full-time remote position.
  • Hiring interviews are online.

description:
Hi ,

Hope you are doing great!

We have the below urgent position with my client. Please reply if you are interested.


Job Title : Client Services Support Tier 1

Location : Mexico/Brazil (Remote)


Must have : Excellent English proficiency (speaking and writing)

Technical background : Experience in Technical support role (on call service), SQL DB knowledge, Log file analysis, Datadog (good to have)


Responsibilities

Serve as a significant interface to customers by handling discovery and fixes on support issues.

Clearly communicate with the product and development teams when a support ticket requires a code or database level change.

Troubleshoot support tickets and determine the best answer for the issue submitted. Consult with other team members to ensure proper resolution on all support tickets.

Qualifications

• Experience with highly accurate data entry

• Clear, concise, and comprehensive writing skills in English

• Experience using async communication tools like Slack

• Knowledge of collaboration tools like Jira and Confluence

• Experience with Microsoft Office Product Suite generally

Candidates should

• Be detail-oriented

• Display critical thinking skills

• Thrive in a multi-tasking environment and adjust priorities on-the-fly

• Be very thorough in writing detailed troubleshooting documentation

• Be a strong team player but still a self-starter

• Show curiosity and deep desire to learn

• Enjoy collaborating with a geographically distributed team

• Support specific coverage needs of Monday to Friday 9am-6pm in UTC-6 (includes flexible hour break)



Thanks, and Regards

Saurabh Kumar | Team Lead

description:
Key Responsibilities

•Realizar manutenções e desenvolvimento de aplicações Cobol para plataformas Mainframe Unisys;

• Definição de requisitos funcionais e não funcionais;

• Definir solução técnica, fazer estimativas de esforço e prazos, assegurando a entrega dentro do cronograma estabelecido.;

• Codificar e realizar testes unitários;

• Atuar em colaboração com o time diariamente para avaliar progresso das atividades e avaliar riscos de projeto, promovendo uma abordagem proativa na resolução de problemas.;

• Contribuir de forma multidisciplinar com objetivo de ajudar o time a atingir as metas, participando ativamente em discussões e oferecendo suporte sempre que necessário;

• Colaborar com outros membros da equipe para promover boas práticas de desenvolvimento e manutenção de software, incentivando a inovação e aprimoramento contínuo.


Key Qualifications

• Conhecimento e experiencia com desenvolvimento de aplicação utilizando Cobol

• Conhecimento e experiencia de trabalho em equipe com métodos ágeis SCRUM ou Kanban, capacidade de adaptação a mudanças, entrega incremental e foco na qualidade e valor do produto;

• Graduação: Sistemas da Informação, Ciência da Computação ou áreas afins;

• Experiência com processos da engenharia de software e desenvolvimento de sistemas, incluindo analise, design, implementação, testes e manutenção;

• Experiencia desenvolvimento ambiente mainframe Unisys, COMS, DMSII, SDF, CANDE

• Conhecimento em testes unitários e de integração automatizados (TDD/ATDD) em rotinas COBOL.

Conhecimento em metodologia BDD;

• Ser flexível, colaborativo e proativo;

• Empatia, capacidade de colaborar em equipe e excelente relacionamento interpessoal;

• Buscar aprendizado constantemente;

• Iniciativa, tomada de decisão e atitude de liderança, Inteligência Emocional.

title: Remote Business Analyst (German) - 54879
description:
About Turing:

Turing is one of the world’s fastest-growing AI companies accelerating the advancement and deployment of powerful AI systems.

Turing helps customers in two ways: Working with the world’s leading AI labs to advance frontier model capabilities in thinking, reasoning, coding, agentic behavior, multimodality, multilinguality, STEM and frontier knowledge; and leveraging that work to build real-world AI systems that solve mission-critical priorities for companies.


Role Overview:

We are looking for candidates with strong analytical and English comprehension skills. The ideal candidate should have the ability to read, summarize, and break down large content into smaller logical blocks, conduct research online, validate claims made in the content through online research, and work with the LLM (Large Language Models) to solve puzzles!

Your role is critical in helping fine-tune and improve large language models (like gpt), and will make you an expert on how to leverage AI to be a better analyst. This is your chance to future-proof your career in an AI-first world!


What does day-to-day look like:

You would spend time answering a variety of interesting analytical questions and creating scenarios that can train the LLM models to get better. Here are a couple of examples which models might get wrong and you would have to give the correct answer and explanation to enable the models to learn:

  • Based on a given distribution of sales by month across locations, could you analyze which location has grown the most? (Hint: what time period should we look at? should we account for sudden variability at the beginning?)
  • In a small town, there are four distinct neighborhoods: Oak, Pine, Maple, and Elm. A postman is assigned to deliver mail and can only deliver to two neighborhoods in one day, with certain rules (e.g. Oak is always visited before Pine). If he delivers to Oak and Elm on the first day, which neighborhoods does the carrier deliver to on the second day? Note: No other prior specialized domain experience is needed.


Requirements:

  • Multilingual capabilities are mandatory. (English and German)
  • Analytical Skills : Good research and analytical skills
  • Feedback Skills : Ability to provide constructive feedback and detailed annotations.
  • Creative Thinking : Creative and lateral thinking abilities.
  • Communication : Excellent communication and collaboration skills.
  • Independence : Self-motivated and able to work independently in a remote setting.
  • Commitment : Ability to commit to 40 hours per week for the contract duration overlapping US hours.
  • Technical Setup : Desktop/Laptop set up with a good internet connection.


Preferred Qualifications:

  • Bachelors degree or undergraduate in Engineering, Literature, Journalism, Communications, Arts, Statistics, or a related field. We are open to candidates who do not have a Bachelor's degree but have experience in the area.
  • Experience writing professionally (business analysts, research analyst, copywriter, journalist, technical writer, editor, translator, etc.)
  • Understanding of Excel and Google Suite.
  • Proficiency in Data interpretation, Logical reasoning and Basic arithmetic is highly desirable.


Perks of Freelancing With Turing:

  • Work in a fully remote environment.
  • Opportunity to work on cutting-edge AI projects with leading LLM companies.
  • Potential for contract extension based on performance and project needs.


Offer Details:

  • Engagement type : Contractor assignment/freelancer (no medical/paid leave)
  • Commitments Required : Availability of up to 40 hours/week is preferred. This role will require some overlap with UTC-8:00 (2-5 hrs/day) America/Los_Angeles


Know amazing talent? Refer them at turing.com/referrals, and earn money from your network.

title: Direct Response Creative Strategist
description:
Direct Response Creative Strategist (Meta Ads Focus)


Company:

Penrose Skin

Location: Fully Remote

Compensation: $50,000 to $72,000 USD per year + Performance Bonus Structure

Job Type: Full-time


The Opportunity

Own the creative engine behind a DTC brand currently spending nearly $700K per month on Meta Ads with a target to scale to $2-3M per month in ad spend this year. You will write the scripts, build the strategy, and drive the ads that take Penrose Skin to the next level. This is a high-impact role for an elite direct response creative strategist who operates with extreme autonomy, understands deep consumer psychology, and wants a direct line to the founders.


About Penrose Skin

We are a premium direct-to-consumer grooming brand known for luxury, pheromone-infused body butters inspired by designer fragrances. From a niche disruptor, we have grown rapidly through viral digital marketing into a highly sought-after grooming essential. With a strong DTC presence and ambitious product launches ahead, this role sits at the absolute center of our next phase of aggressive scaling.


What You Will Do

Scale the Account: Push our Meta ad spend from its current $700K per month toward $2-3M per month while maintaining or improving ROAS through relentless creative testing and iteration.

Deep Psychological Strategy: Build concepts based on deep customer personas and match specific marketing frameworks (unaware, problem-aware, solution-aware) to those personas and their desires.

High-Volume Output: Produce a high volume of quality concepts weekly, working seamlessly with our graphic designers and leveraging AI tools (like nanobanana pro) to build statics on your own.

Scientific Iteration: Run \"learnings\" on every single creative. Form a hypothesis, test it, analyze why it worked or failed, and iterate on the winners relentlessly.

UGC and Content Mastery: Build and improve systems to source UGC, brief creators, manage AI video creatives, and oversee the production of high-converting assets.


What We Are Looking For

Proven Scale: You have a documented track record of managing creative strategy for Meta ad accounts spending $500K+ per month and have helped scale ad spend to $1M+ per month.

Extreme Autonomy: You do not wait for instructions. You get things done, build systems, and take full ownership of the creative pipeline without being asked.

Psychology Expert: You deeply understand consumer awareness stages, emotional hooks, personas, and how to write copy that converts cold traffic for specific audience segments.

AI and Format Fluent: You are up-to-date with the latest AI tech for ad creation (statics, video, AI-generated content) and know how to design listicles, advertorials, and hybrid MOF/BOF ads.

Obsessive Learner: You are addicted to learning, improving, and analyzing data to beat your own control ads. You stay on top of every new tool and trend in the space.


Our Culture

We are not a corporate 9-to-5. We are a small, obsessive team that plays to win.

We believe discipline beats motivation, every single day. We go all in, execute relentlessly, and hold ourselves to excruciatingly high standards because great is simply not good enough. We take full responsibility for our results. No excuses, no blame, no waiting to be saved.

We stay focused. We eliminate distractions. We embrace resistance because the sword can only be forged under fire.

We are radically honest, delusionally optimistic, and deeply grateful, but never satisfied.

If that sounds exhausting, this is not for you. If it sounds like home, we want to talk.

UGC and Content Mastery: Build and improve systems to source UGC, brief creators, manage AI video creatives, and oversee the production of high-converting assets.


What We Are Looking For

Proven Scale: You have a documented track record of managing creative strategy for Meta ad accounts spending $500K+ per month and have helped scale ad spend to $1M+ per month.

Extreme Autonomy: You do not wait for instructions. You get things done, build systems, and take full ownership of the creative pipeline without being asked.

Psychology Expert: You deeply understand consumer awareness stages, emotional hooks, personas, and how to write copy that converts cold traffic for specific audience segments.

AI and Format Fluent: You are up-to-date with the latest AI tech for ad creation (statics, video, AI-generated content) and know how to design listicles, advertorials, and hybrid MOF/BOF ads.

Obsessive Learner: You are addicted to learning, improving, and analyzing data to beat your own control ads. You stay on top of every new tool and trend in the space.


Our Culture

We are not a corporate 9-to-5. We are a small, obsessive team that plays to win.

We believe discipline beats motivation, every single day. We go all in, execute relentlessly, and hold ourselves to excruciatingly high standards because great is simply not good enough. We take full responsibility for our results. No excuses, no blame, no waiting to be saved.

We stay focused. We eliminate distractions. We embrace resistance because the sword can only be forged under fire.

We are radically honest, delusionally optimistic, and deeply grateful, but never satisfied.

If that sounds exhausting, this is not for you. If it sounds like home, we want to talk.

title: Técnico Suporte ao Usuário - Bilíngue Inglês
description:
Sobre nós


A Atos é uma líder global em transformação digital, com cerca de 94.000 colaboradores e uma receita anual de aproximadamente €11 bilhões de euros. Número um na Europa em cibersegurança, nuvem e computação de alto desempenho, o Grupo oferece soluções personalizadas de ponta a ponta para todos os setores em 69 países. Pioneira em serviços e produtos de descarbonização, a Atos está comprometida com um ambiente digital seguro e descarbonizado para seus clientes. A Atos é uma SE (Societas Europaea) e está listada na Euronext Paris.


Sobre a Vaga


Técnico Suporte ao Usuário 1N I

Horário de trabalho: segunda à sexta-feira, das 8:00 às 17:00 ou 10:00 às 19:00.

Modalidade: Presencial


Requisitos


  • Ensino Médio Completo;
  • Conhecimento intermediário/avançado em inglês;
  • Experiência em atividades de atendimento e/ou suporte em TI;
  • Boa comunicação e facilidade em trabalhar em equipe;
  • Comprometimento com diretrizes e qualidade de atendimento.


O que você vai fazer


  • Atender solicitações de chamados de suporte em TI;
  • Resolver incidentes de acordo com processos estabelecidos (metodologia ITIL).
  • Dar suporte a dúvidas e orientações sobre informática.
  • Registrar e protocolar incidentes, seguindo os padrões de qualidade.


Benefícios


✓ Vale refeição ou Vale alimentação

✓ Plano de saúde extensível a cônjuge e filhos

✓ Plano odontológico

✓ Programa de remuneração variável

✓ Vale transporte

✓ Auxílio creche - conforme regras sindicais da localidade

✓ Wellhub (Gympass)

✓ Convênio com farmácias – descontos em medicamentos

✓ Previdência Privada com seguro de vida adicional

✓ Seguro de vida

✓ Empréstimo Consignado (após 1 ano de empresa)

✓ Convênio com empresas parceiras (Descontos para realização de graduação, pós-graduação, MBA e Idiomas)

✓ Política de Subsídios para Pós-graduação, MBAs e Certificações (A Atos apoia o seu desenvolvimento, subsidiando financeiramente ações externas)

✓ Speexx (curso online de até 5 idiomas gratuitamente)

✓ Programa de treinamentos internos e externos

✓ Universidade corporativa (E-learning com milhares de cursos disponíveis gratuitamente)

✓ Espaço Saúde (suporte com atendimento médico - presencial ou online - para os funcionários e seus familiares e contamos também com os programas de bem-estar e qualidade de vida)

✓ Terapia online

✓ Programa de acompanhamento à gestante (acompanhamento médico online durante a gestação para colaboradoras ou cônjuges)

✓ Trabalho remoto para gestantes

✓ Programa Minha Nova Parceria de Confiança (para colaboradores e cônjuges. Válido também para filhos adotivos) - Brinde especial + Cartão presente com valor em dinheiro

✓ Accolade (Programa de reconhecimento)

title: .NET Software Engineer
description:
A Job? Or a Lifetime Experience? Start Yours Here!


We are a Portuguese technology consulting company with a strong outward look to the rest of Europe. We have 12 years of experience in the market and reached the status of \"large company\" in 2018. We now have more than 400 associates and we keep growing, with offices in Lisbon, Porto, and Leiria, as well as projects in more than 20 countries. Our company is part of the national top 10, with a growth of 250% in the last years.


Work-life balance is part of our DNA. We focus on win-win-win relationships, defining every moment of interaction as an experience with unique conditions. Working with Affinity is a \"Lifetime Experience\" where you will have the opportunity to demonstrate all your potential and to be successful on every level.


#welcometoyourfuture


What you need to have

  • College degree in Computer Science, IT Engineering, or similar;
  • 5–6 years of experience in .NET development;
  • Strong knowledge of C# and object-oriented programming principles;
  • Experience with microservice architecture and RESTful APIs;
  • Solid experience with relational databases (PostgreSQL) and non-relational databases (MongoDB);
  • Familiarity with Kafka or similar event streaming platforms;
  • Proficiency with ADO.NET and Entity Framework;
  • Experience with DevOps practices and CI/CD pipelines;


What we expect from you

  • Will to exceed expectations (your own and the ones defined by Affinity);
  • Exceptional skills and the will to acquire more;
  • Good people skills (not just in terms of technology, language, and platforms), team spirit, and pleasant disposition;
  • Autonomy, proactivity, and focus (even under pressure);
  • Obsession for doing things right, and ability to prioritize;
  • Versatility (you can be a fan of BYOD or not);
  • Ability to innovate and evolve in a market in constant mutation.


What will encourage you

  • Being part of a company that has a disruptive action in the technology market;
  • Being part of a technology focused on relationships, simplicity, and efficiency;
  • Accessing a generative career directly proportional to your performance and interest;
  • The real possibility of being part of our company staff.


Do you think you're the one we are looking for?

Let's chat! Send your application and take a look at:

title: Operador(a) de máquinas
description:
Sobre nós:

Furukawa Electric LatAm, Furukawa Electric Fiber & Cable e OFS agora são Lightera

Lightera é mais do que um nome, é um compromisso com a criação de conexões mais brilhantes que moldam o futuro.


O nome Lightera combina as palavras light (luz) e era, simbolizando um novo capítulo iluminado pelo poder transformador da luz. Isso reflete nossas raízes na tecnologia de fibra óptica e nossa visão de liderar o caminho para um futuro mais brilhante e mais conectado.


A Lightera está com vagas abertas para Operador(a) de Máquinas e busca pessoas comprometidas, que gostem de desafios e desejem evoluir junto com a empresa.


Aqui, você fará parte de um ambiente industrial moderno, com foco em segurança, qualidade, melhoria contínua e desenvolvimento de pessoas.


Vaga: Operador(a) de Máquinas

Área: Fábrica de Cabos

Local: Cidade Industrial de Curitiba

Modelo de trabalho: Fixo

Horário: Turnos e/ou escala 3x3


REQUISITOS:

  • Ensino Médio completo;
  • Disponibilidade para atuar em turnos e/ou escala 3x3;
  • Residir em Curitiba ou Região Metropolitana, com fácil acesso à região da CIC;
  • Conhecimentos básicos de leitura e interpretação de instruções de trabalho e procedimentos operacionais;
  • Disponibilidade para realização de horas extras, quando necessário.


DIFERENCIAIS:

  • Experiência anterior como Operador(a) de Máquinas em ambiente industrial;
  • Curso de Mecânica Básica Industrial, Processos Industriais ou áreas correlatas;
  • Conhecimento em ferramentas de melhoria contínua, como 5S, Kaizen, TPM ou Lean Manufacturing;
  • Experiência com controle de qualidade visual e/ou dimensional;
  • Vivência em empresas dos segmentos metalúrgico, elétrico ou de cabos/fibras ópticas.


ATRIBUIÇÕES:

  • Operar máquinas fixas nos processos de trefilação, binagem, reunião, extrusão de isolamento, capa e tubo, pintura de fibras e fracionamento de cabos ópticos e eletrônicos, conforme os padrões operacionais;
  • Realizar inspeções durante o processo produtivo, assegurando a conformidade dos produtos com as normas internas de qualidade;
  • Monitorar os parâmetros de processo, identificando desvios e comunicando a liderança quando necessário;
  • Abastecer as máquinas e organizar os materiais conforme o fluxo produtivo;
  • Atuar de forma ativa nos programas de Melhoria Contínua, contribuindo para a redução de custos, desperdícios e aumento da produtividade;
  • Aplicar diariamente os conceitos do Programa 5S;
  • Utilizar as ferramentas e métodos do Sistema de Produção da empresa para a identificação e solução de problemas;
  • Movimentar materiais utilizando paleteiras manuais ou elétricas, respeitando as normas de segurança;
  • Zelar pela organização, limpeza e conservação do posto de trabalho e dos equipamentos;


Faça parte de nossa missão de moldar o futuro da conectividade.

title: Full Stack Engineer (Java/Angular) - Relocation to Portugal
description:
Aubay Portugal is a French multinational company that has been operating in the country since 2007, with offices in Lisbon and Porto. We are a leading technology consultancy with a presence in seven European Union countries, specializing in the management, implementation, development and maintenance of information systems.

With more than 150 active partners, we operate in strategic sectors such as banking, insurance, automotive, aviation, telecommunications, services and energy, driving innovation and digital transformation.

Excellence, proximity and innovation are the pillars that distinguish us and enable us to support companies in building technological solutions that make a difference.


What are we looking for?

  • At least 4 years of professional experience in Java development;
  • Experience with cloud environments and modern backend systems;
  • Hands-on experience with Spring Boot and microservices architecture;
  • Experience working with Apache Kafka;
  • Experience with Angular for frontend development;
  • English level B2 or higher, with the ability to communicate effectively;
  • Ability to communicate in Portuguese;
  • Willingness to relocate from Brazil to Portugal;
  • Available to work in Porto or Lisbon (hybrid work model).


What do we have to offer you?

  • Comprehensive health insurance, including dental coverage;
  • Feedback&Coffee – our integrated performance management system, with regular feedback sessions and a structured Career Progression Model;
  • Aubay Training Academy, designed for your development: technical and behavioural training (in-class and e-learning), Meet&Techs, Webinars, Mentoring and Technology Centers;
  • Events and team building activities that strengthen team spirit and promote closeness;
  • Digital platform for mental health and emotional well-being, with free psychology consultations, so you can take care of yourself at any time;
  • Health and well-being programme, with workshops and initiatives for our employees and other activities open to the community;
  • We grow with you and your family - we offer a Mini-Aubilous Kit when your children are born and annual support for school supplies, from pre-school to higher education;
  • Language platform, with conversation classes in 12 languages;
  • Working model: hybrid.


What makes us different?

  • Our organisational culture is based on solid values: commitment, excellence, team spirit, well-being, happiness and empathy;
  • We value and recognise those who are part of our history, with referral awards and a special birthday gift;
  • We believe in authenticity: we don't have a dress code, because what matters is talent and attitude;
  • We promote closeness and an informal environment;
  • Here, you will grow in good company, because we believe that professional development also means sharing experiences and building relationships.


Your next adventure starts here!

If you can see yourself growing with us, take the first step and send your CV to: .

The future is waiting for you — and so are we!

title: Consultor SAP BUILD WORK ZONE - SPOT
description:
O que procuramos?

Estamos em busca de um Especialista SAP Sênior com foco em SAP Build Work Zone para integrar uma operação estratégica de suporte direto da SAP. O perfil ideal deve possuir uma visão holística do ecossistema SAP, sendo capaz de transitar entre ambientes S/4HANA, BTP e versões On-Premise.

Buscamos um profissional resiliente, com perfil consultivo e alta capacidade analítica para atuar em um Centro de Serviços Compartilhados.   • Atuar no suporte especializado e sustentação de ambientes utilizando SAP Build Work Zone (Standard e Advanced editions);
  • Configurar e administrar portais corporativos, garantindo a integração fluida entre S/4HANA, sistemas On-Premise e serviços em nuvem;

  • Desenvolver e manter workspaces, páginas, widgets e cartões de integração (UI Integration Cards);
  • Gerenciar permissões, papéis (roles) e a governança de conteúdo dentro do Business Technology Platform (BTP);
  • Colaborar com as equipes de infraestrutura e segurança para garantir a conectividade via Cloud Connector;
  • Documentar soluções técnicas e apoiar na transferência de conhecimento para a operação de suporte.


Requisitos:

  • Experiência sólida e comprovada em SAP Build Work Zone (antigo SAP Launchpad Service e SAP Jam);
  • Domínio do ecossistema SAP BTP (Business Technology Platform);
  • Experiência prévia em suporte ou implementação de projetos envolvendo S/4HANA e versões SAP On-Premise;
  • Conhecimento profundo em integração de sistemas e conectividade (SAP Cloud Connector e Destinations);
  • Vivência em Centros de Suporte ou Centros de Serviços Compartilhados (CSC);
  • Capacidade de atuar de forma autônoma em um ambiente remoto, gerindo prioridades e prazos (SLA/OLA).


Diferenciais:

  • Conhecimento em outras ferramentas da família SAP Build (Build Apps ou Build Process Automation);
  • Experiência com SAP Fiori / UI5 para customizações avançadas;
  • Certificações oficiais em SAP BTP ou SAP Extension Suite;
  • Inglês técnico para leitura de documentação e interação com suporte global da SAP.

Remoto

title: GHL Support + Junior Developer
description:
Company Description

Fabri Holdings is a forward-thinking company focused on consulting other companies to help them grow and scale til their full potential is reached. To help us, we're now looking for a Developer + AI Support Specialist that can help our clients grow with our help.


Role Description

The role involves designing, developing, and maintaining software solutions, providing technical support for AI-driven systems, and troubleshooting issues. The individual will also collaborate with cross-functional teams to address technical challenges, enhance existing systems, and ensure optimal system functionality. Strong analytical capabilities and effective communication will be critical in delivering seamless solutions.


Qualifications

  • GHL: sub-accounts, custom fields, pipelines, calendars, conversations
  • Workflows & automations, Custom Code Action (JS), webhooks
  • E-commerce in GHL: products, order forms, payment gateways (Stripe)
  • Funnels, Page Builder
  • Snapshots: create, load, update
  • Affiliate Manager: campaigns, commissions, payouts
  • A2P 10DLC & Toll-Free submission and troubleshooting
  • GHL API v2: OAuth, webhooks, rate limits
  • Backend: Node.js (Express/Nest)
  • Frontend: React
  • AI support: prompt engineering, RAG, escalation rules, empathetic tone
  • Detail-oriented, clear written English
  • Peptides experience a plus


Salary

3k USD/month

title: Remote Business Analyst - 57510
description:
bout Turing:

Based in San Francisco, California, Turing is the world’s leading research accelerator for frontier AI labs and a trusted partner for global enterprises deploying advanced AI systems.

Turing supports customers in two ways: first, by accelerating frontier research with high-quality data, advanced training pipelines, plus top AI researchers who specialize in coding, reasoning, STEM, multilinguality, multimodality, and agents; and second, by applying that expertise to help enterprises transform AI from proof of concept into proprietary intelligence with systems that perform reliably, deliver measurable impact, and drive lasting results on the P&L


About the Role:

We are looking for a detail-oriented Business Analyst to support evaluation and annotation workflows focused on quality, accuracy, and structured reasoning. This role is ideal for someone who is comfortable working with digital tools, performing side-by-side evaluations, and providing clear, well-supported justifications based on fact-checking.


Responsibilities:

  • Perform side-by-side (SxS) evaluations on GHD, comparing outputs and assessing quality, accuracy, and relevance.
  • Conduct fact-checking to validate information and identify inconsistencies or inaccuracies.
  • Provide detailed, well-structured justifications to support evaluation decisions.
  • Follow established evaluation guidelines and quality standards consistently.
  • Use browser-based tools and extensions to support analysis and review tasks.
  • Execute simple command-line instructions when required to support evaluation workflows.
  • Document findings clearly and communicate insights to stakeholders when needed.


Requirements:

  • Solid comfort using a computer in a professional setting.
  • Experience working with browser extensions and online tools.
  • Ability to run basic command-line commands (no advanced programming required).
  • Strong analytical and critical thinking skills.
  • High attention to detail and ability to justify decisions clearly and objectively.
  • Comfortable working with evaluation frameworks, comparisons, and structured analysis.
  • Good written communication skills in English.


Nice to Have:

  • Previous experience with evaluation, annotation, QA, or audit-type work.
  • Familiarity with data quality, content evaluation, or model/output assessments.
  • Background in business analysis, operations, or process improvement.


Perks of Freelancing With Turing:

  • Competitive compensation based on experience and expertise.
  • Flexible working hours and a fully remote environment.
  • Opportunity to contribute to impactful research initiatives.
  • Potential for contract extension based on performance and project needs.


Offer Details:

  • Commitment Required: 30 hours per week minimum.
  • Engagement Type: Contractor/Freelancer (no medical or paid leave).
  • Time Overlap: Some overlap with UTC-8:00 (2–5 hrs/day) America/Los_Angeles.


Application Process:

  • Shortlisted candidates will be invited to complete an analytical challenge.
  • Once the assessment is cleared, you’re ready to start contributing!


After applying, you will receive an email with a login link. Please use that link to access the portal and complete your profile.


Know amazing talent? Refer them at turing.com/referrals, and earn money from your network.

title: Remote Business Analyst - 57510
description:
bout Turing:

Based in San Francisco, California, Turing is the world’s leading research accelerator for frontier AI labs and a trusted partner for global enterprises deploying advanced AI systems.

Turing supports customers in two ways: first, by accelerating frontier research with high-quality data, advanced training pipelines, plus top AI researchers who specialize in coding, reasoning, STEM, multilinguality, multimodality, and agents; and second, by applying that expertise to help enterprises transform AI from proof of concept into proprietary intelligence with systems that perform reliably, deliver measurable impact, and drive lasting results on the P&L


About the Role:

We are looking for a detail-oriented Business Analyst to support evaluation and annotation workflows focused on quality, accuracy, and structured reasoning. This role is ideal for someone who is comfortable working with digital tools, performing side-by-side evaluations, and providing clear, well-supported justifications based on fact-checking.


Responsibilities:

  • Perform side-by-side (SxS) evaluations on GHD, comparing outputs and assessing quality, accuracy, and relevance.
  • Conduct fact-checking to validate information and identify inconsistencies or inaccuracies.
  • Provide detailed, well-structured justifications to support evaluation decisions.
  • Follow established evaluation guidelines and quality standards consistently.
  • Use browser-based tools and extensions to support analysis and review tasks.
  • Execute simple command-line instructions when required to support evaluation workflows.
  • Document findings clearly and communicate insights to stakeholders when needed.


Requirements:

  • Solid comfort using a computer in a professional setting.
  • Experience working with browser extensions and online tools.
  • Ability to run basic command-line commands (no advanced programming required).
  • Strong analytical and critical thinking skills.
  • High attention to detail and ability to justify decisions clearly and objectively.
  • Comfortable working with evaluation frameworks, comparisons, and structured analysis.
  • Good written communication skills in English.


Nice to Have:

  • Previous experience with evaluation, annotation, QA, or audit-type work.
  • Familiarity with data quality, content evaluation, or model/output assessments.
  • Background in business analysis, operations, or process improvement.


Perks of Freelancing With Turing:

  • Competitive compensation based on experience and expertise.
  • Flexible working hours and a fully remote environment.
  • Opportunity to contribute to impactful research initiatives.
  • Potential for contract extension based on performance and project needs.


Offer Details:

  • Commitment Required: 30 hours per week minimum.
  • Engagement Type: Contractor/Freelancer (no medical or paid leave).
  • Time Overlap: Some overlap with UTC-8:00 (2–5 hrs/day) America/Los_Angeles.


Application Process:

  • Shortlisted candidates will be invited to complete an analytical challenge.
  • Once the assessment is cleared, you’re ready to start contributing!


After applying, you will receive an email with a login link. Please use that link to access the portal and complete your profile.


Know amazing talent? Refer them at turing.com/referrals, and earn money from your network.

title: Salesforce System Analyst
description:
Job Title: Salesforce System Analyst

Location: Brazil

Duration: 6-12 months with possible extension or FTE conversion


Introduction:

We are seeking a skilled Salesforce System Analyst with 5 to 10 years of experience to join our dynamic team. This role is critical in driving the optimization and enhancement of our Sales Cloud platform, ensuring seamless Salesforce migration , effective Salesforce administration , and robust system configuration and implementation . The Salesforce System Analyst will play a pivotal role in aligning our CRM capabilities with business goals, improving sales processes, and enabling data-driven decision-making across the organization.


Roles and Responsibilities:

  • Lead and manage end-to-end Salesforce migration projects, ensuring data integrity and minimal disruption to business operations.
  • Perform comprehensive Salesforce administration tasks, including user management, security settings, and system maintenance.
  • Configure and customize Sales Cloud features to meet evolving business requirements, including workflows, validation rules, and custom objects.
  • Collaborate with stakeholders to gather requirements, analyze business processes, and translate them into scalable technical solutions within Salesforce .
  • Drive the implementation of new Salesforce functionalities and third-party integrations to enhance system capabilities.
  • Monitor system performance and troubleshoot issues to maintain optimal platform efficiency.
  • Develop and maintain detailed documentation related to system configurations, processes, and best practices.
  • Provide training and support to end-users to maximize adoption and utilization of Salesforce tools.
  • Stay updated on the latest Salesforce releases and industry trends to recommend innovative solutions.


Qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Business Administration, or a related field.
  • 5 to 10 years of proven experience as a Salesforce System Analyst or similar role.
  • Salesforce certifications such as Salesforce Administrator (ADM 201) , Salesforce Platform App Builder , or relevant advanced certifications are highly desirable.
  • Strong understanding of Sales Cloud functionalities and CRM best practices.
  • Demonstrated experience in Salesforce migration , administration, configuration , and implementation projects.
  • Excellent analytical, problem-solving, and communication skills.
  • Ability to work collaboratively with cross-functional teams and manage multiple priorities.


Tools and Technologies:

  • Salesforce Sales Cloud
  • Salesforce Administration tools and features
  • Salesforce Migration tools (e.g., Data Loader, Salesforce DX)
  • Salesforce Configuration and Customization tools (Workflows, Process Builder, Flow Builder)
  • Integration tools (e.g., MuleSoft, REST/SOAP APIs)
  • Reporting and Dashboard tools within Salesforce
  • Version control and collaboration platforms (e.g., Git, Jira)


Skills:

Sales Cloud, Salesforce migration, Salesforce administration, Configuration, Implementation

title: Software Engineer
description:
Software Engineer


Technical Requirements

  • Expert level proficiency in React Native for building highperformance reusable components for both iOS and Android
  • State Management Mastery of Redux, MobX or React Context API for managing complex application states and offline data persistence
  • Experience writing Native Bridges JavaKotlin for Android Objective CSwift for iOS to access device specific features not covered by standard React Native APIs
  • Deep expertise in optimizing app render times, memory usage and battery consumption
  • Navigation Proficiency with React Navigation or React Native Navigation for complex screen flows
  • Mobile Ecosystem Tooling
  • Expert use of Metro Bundler, Xcode and Android Studio for building debugging and profiling applications
  • Experience managing the end-to-end release process for the Apple App Store and Google Play Store including TestFlight and Beta testing
  • Code Push Proficiency in using Microsoft CodePush for overtheair OTA updates to bypass traditional store review cycles for critical hotfixes


Secondary Technical Skills: Integration DevOps

  • Backend API Integration
  • REST GraphQL Deep understanding of consuming complex APIs handling authentication OAuth2JWT and managing data synchronization
  • Experience implementing offline capabilities using WatermelonDB Realm or SQLite to support field users with intermittent connectivity
  • Mobile DevOps Quality
  • CI/CD Pipelines Experience with Fastlane, Bitrise or Azure DevOps for automated mobile build and deployment pipelines
  • Testing Proficiency in Jest for unit testing and Detox or Appium for end-to-end E2E automation
  • Expert use of Firebase Crashlytics or Sentry to monitor app health and perform proactive bug fixing


Key Responsibilities: AMS Context

  • Mobile App Support Lead the resolution of Tier 2 and Tier 3 incidents affecting global mobile users from UI glitches to critical sync failures
  • OS Compatibility Proactively manage app updates to ensure compatibility with the latest iOS and Android versions and hardware releases
  • Complex Change Requests Translate requirements from Sales and Marketing leads into technical mobile features Design develop and test enhancements
  • Root Cause Analysis RCA Perform deepdive analysis on app crashes API timeouts or data inconsistencies implementing permanent architectural fixes
  • SLA Stewardship Ensure all mobile services meet strict Service Level Agreements SLAs for our 24/7 global field operations
  • Technical Mentorship Act as the Subject Matter Expert SME for React Native in the India hub providing guidance to junior developers and UI/UX designers


Preferred Skills

  • Experience with TypeScript for typesafe React Native development
  • Familiarity with SAP Fiori for mobile or SAP Mobile Services
  • Knowledge of Bluetooth IoT integration for warehouse scanning applications
  • Experience with mobile security best practices biometrics certificate pinning

title: Senior Mobile Developer
description:
Senior Mobile Developer


Role Purpose

As a Mobile Developer Senior Developer you will be responsible for architecting and building high performance enterprise grade mobile applications within the Experience Engineering and Digital Emerging Tech portfolios. This role focuses on leveraging React Native and the Salesforce Mobile SDK to deliver offline first data rich applications for a global FMCG leader. You will integrate advanced capabilities like OpenCV for image processing and manage complex local data using Smart Store, ensuring a seamless mobile experience within a hyper scaler heavy application landscape.


Key Responsibilities

  • CrossPlatform Development: Design and develop robust mobile applications for iOS and Android using React Native
  • Salesforce Integration: Implement and customize mobile solutions using the Salesforce Mobile SDK ensuring seamless synchronization between mobile devices and Salesforce clouds
  • Offline Data Management: Architect Offline First capabilities using Smart Store DB, Salesforce SmartStore and SmartSync to manage complex local data persistence and synchronization
  • Computer Vision Integration: Implement image processing and computer vision features, eg shelf scanning asset recognition or document processing using OpenCV within the mobile environment
  • State Management: Manage complex application states and data flows using Redux or Redux Toolkit
  • Experience Engineering: Build highfidelity responsive UIs that provide superior user journeys for fieldforce users and consumers adhering to global brand standards
  • Version Control CI/CD: Manage source code branching strategies and pull requests using GitHub integrated with automated mobile build pipelines
  • Emerging Tech Pilots: Support Digital Emerging Technology initiatives by prototyping mobile first AIML features and integrating with hyper scaler hosted APIs eg GCP Vision AI

title: Full Stack Engineer
description:
Job Description: Full Stack Developer (2 Openings)

Location: Remote from Barzil & Mexico

Experience Level: Mid–Senior

One role will be .NET-heavy , and the other Angular-heavy , though both are full stack positions.

Role Overview

We are hiring two Full Stack Developers to support the Digital Signage & Clubs team, building and maintaining software that powers airport signage systems and United Club applications used by customers and employees across airport locations.

These roles focus on developing scalable, cloud-based applications that support real-time signage displays, premium services, and club access platforms.

Responsibilities

  • Design, build, and maintain full stack applications supporting digital signage and club systems
  • Develop front-end experiences using Angular (role-dependent emphasis)
  • Build backend services using .NET Core (latest versions)
  • Integrate applications with NoSQL databases such as DynamoDB and DocumentDB
  • Deploy and support applications in AWS
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams including product, UX, and infrastructure
  • Support ongoing enhancements, performance improvements, and new feature development

Required Skills & Experience

  • Strong full stack development experience
  • Angular (front-end focus for one role)
  • .NET Core and modern .NET ecosystem (backend focus for one role)
  • Experience with AWS cloud services
  • Hands-on experience with NoSQL databases , including DynamoDB and/or DocumentDB
  • Experience building scalable, production-grade applications

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience supporting digital signage, real-time display systems, or customer-facing platforms
  • Familiarity with applications used in high-traffic public environments
  • Experience working on systems supporting both customer and employee workflows

title: Senior Data Engineer
description:
Data Engineer / Senior Data Engineer

Location: Costa Rica, Brazil or Mexico

Focus: Digital & Customer Experience Applications


Role Summary

We are seeking a Data Engineer / Senior Data Engineer to design, build, and operate scalable data pipelines and curated datasets. This role is pivotal in enabling Digital and Customer Experience applications across our global enterprise. You will work hands-on with Python, PySpark, and Databricks, championing modern engineering practices through Git-based workflows, CI/CD, and Azure DevOps to ensure high-quality data delivery.

Key Responsibilities

  • Pipeline Development: Design and optimize ETL/ELT pipelines using Databricks and PySpark to transform and serve data for digital customer journeys.
  • Data Modeling: Build performant SQL transformations and curated dimensional data layers for downstream analytics and application consumption.
  • Engineering Excellence: Implement best practices for Databricks (notebooks vs. repos), modular code, cluster configuration, and cost-aware performance tuning.
  • Automation & Scripting: Utilize Python for data validation, orchestration helpers, and the creation of reusable libraries.
  • DevOps & CI/CD: * Manage source control via Git (GitHub/Bitbucket), enforcing strict PR reviews and branching strategies.
  • Build and maintain Azure DevOps pipelines to automate testing, packaging, and deployment across environments.
  • Quality & Reliability: Ensure data integrity through automated reconciliation checks, monitoring, and detailed operational runbooks.
  • Collaboration: Partner with product teams, analysts, and platform engineers to translate complex requirements into scalable data products.
  • Leadership (Senior Level): Lead module-level design, mentor junior engineers, and take ownership of critical pipeline delivery and enterprise code standards.


Technical Skills

Primary (Must-Have)

  • Advanced Data Engineering: Expert-level Python , PySpark , and SQL (advanced querying and optimization).
  • Databricks Ecosystem: Proficiency in Databricks jobs, workflows, clusters, and repos.
  • Version Control: Strong experience with Git (GitHub and/or Bitbucket) and enterprise branching workflows.
  • Azure DevOps: Hands-on experience with Boards, Repos, and Pipelines for build/release automation in data workloads.

Secondary (Good-to-Have)

  • Orchestration: Experience with Azure Data Factory (ADF) for ingestion and scheduling patterns.
  • Data Visualization: Understanding of Power BI datasets, measures, and refresh patterns to support analytics enablement.

title: Data Engineer
description:
About FirstIgnite:

FirstIgnite builds best-in-class software that accelerates commercialization and innovation by connecting scientific research with industry partners. We support universities, national labs, and research hospitals worldwide with tools that simplify complex science and identify real partnership opportunities.


Role Overview:

The Data Engineer will lead the design, development, and maintenance of scalable data systems that integrate diverse datasets. This role includes deploying AI and machine learning solutions to enhance insights, manage complex data relationships, and drive actionable intelligence for FirstIgnite’s platform. You will mentor and manage a team of data engineers while working cross-functionally to innovate and deliver impactful AI-driven solutions.


Responsibilities :

  • Lead the architecture, development, and optimization of scalable data pipelines for patents, grants, clinical trials, publications, labs, and firmographic sources.
  • Build and maintain ETL workflows on AWS using Glue (PySpark), Lambda, S3, and RDS PostgreSQL.
  • Explore and implement complementary data storage solutions as needed.
  • Apply machine learning and LLM-based techniques to extract, structure, and enrich data at scale.
  • Ensure data integrity, security, accuracy, and governance across all systems.
  • Implement tools for data exploration, visualization, and actionable insights.
  • Collaborate with Product, Engineering, and Customer Success teams to drive AI-driven innovation.
  • Evaluate emerging AI/ML techniques and tools to enhance platform capabilities.
  • Maintain version control, CI/CD pipelines, and reproducible workflows for the data engineering team.


Requirements :

  • Strong programming expertise in Python, with experience building production data pipelines.
  • Hands-on experience with AWS data services (Glue/PySpark, Lambda, S3, RDS PostgreSQL, SSM) or equivalent cloud data stacks.
  • Familiarity with RESTful and GraphQL APIs, ETL processes, and data integration strategies.
  • Understanding of Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) and AI-enhanced data applications.
  • Strong analytical skills, including evaluating trade-offs of data ingestion and storage methods.
  • Leadership experience managing data engineering or AI teams in SaaS or tech environments.
  • Solid knowledge of version control (Git) and CI/CD practices.
  • Exposure to data science / ML libraries (Pandas, Scikit-learn, PyTorch) and managed ML platforms (SageMaker, Vertex AI) is a plus.
  • Excellent problem-solving, collaboration, and communication skills in cross-functional teams.
  • Ability to work independently, prioritize tasks, and drive projects from conception to deployment.


Additional Qualifications:

  • Experience with web scraping at scale (Firecrawl or similar).
  • LLM-based data extraction and prompt engineering for structured output.
  • Data quality instrumentation and observability for pipelines.

title: Data Engineer
description:
About FirstIgnite:

FirstIgnite builds best-in-class software that accelerates commercialization and innovation by connecting scientific research with industry partners. We support universities, national labs, and research hospitals worldwide with tools that simplify complex science and identify real partnership opportunities.


Role Overview:

The Data Engineer will lead the design, development, and maintenance of scalable data systems that integrate diverse datasets. This role includes deploying AI and machine learning solutions to enhance insights, manage complex data relationships, and drive actionable intelligence for FirstIgnite’s platform. You will mentor and manage a team of data engineers while working cross-functionally to innovate and deliver impactful AI-driven solutions.


Responsibilities :

  • Lead the architecture, development, and optimization of scalable data pipelines for patents, grants, clinical trials, publications, labs, and firmographic sources.
  • Build and maintain ETL workflows on AWS using Glue (PySpark), Lambda, S3, and RDS PostgreSQL.
  • Explore and implement complementary data storage solutions as needed.
  • Apply machine learning and LLM-based techniques to extract, structure, and enrich data at scale.
  • Ensure data integrity, security, accuracy, and governance across all systems.
  • Implement tools for data exploration, visualization, and actionable insights.
  • Collaborate with Product, Engineering, and Customer Success teams to drive AI-driven innovation.
  • Evaluate emerging AI/ML techniques and tools to enhance platform capabilities.
  • Maintain version control, CI/CD pipelines, and reproducible workflows for the data engineering team.


Requirements :

  • Strong programming expertise in Python, with experience building production data pipelines.
  • Hands-on experience with AWS data services (Glue/PySpark, Lambda, S3, RDS PostgreSQL, SSM) or equivalent cloud data stacks.
  • Familiarity with RESTful and GraphQL APIs, ETL processes, and data integration strategies.
  • Understanding of Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) and AI-enhanced data applications.
  • Strong analytical skills, including evaluating trade-offs of data ingestion and storage methods.
  • Leadership experience managing data engineering or AI teams in SaaS or tech environments.
  • Solid knowledge of version control (Git) and CI/CD practices.
  • Exposure to data science / ML libraries (Pandas, Scikit-learn, PyTorch) and managed ML platforms (SageMaker, Vertex AI) is a plus.
  • Excellent problem-solving, collaboration, and communication skills in cross-functional teams.
  • Ability to work independently, prioritize tasks, and drive projects from conception to deployment.


Additional Qualifications:

  • Experience with web scraping at scale (Firecrawl or similar).
  • LLM-based data extraction and prompt engineering for structured output.
  • Data quality instrumentation and observability for pipelines.

title: Citrix Engineer - Relocation to Portugal
description:
Your connection with Aubay starts in the following lines:

Aubay Portugal is a French multinational company that has been operating in the country since 2007, with offices in Lisbon and Porto. We are a leading technology consultancy with a presence in seven European Union countries, specializing in the management, implementation, development and maintenance of information systems.

With more than 150 active partners, we operate in strategic sectors such as banking, insurance, automotive, aviation, telecommunications, services and energy, driving innovation and digital transformation.

Excellence, proximity and innovation are the pillars that distinguish us and enable us to support companies in building technological solutions that make a difference.


What are we looking for?

  • More than 4 years as a Citrix Engineer ;
  • Experience with Citrix Legacy (produts);
  • Knowledge of Citrix Cloud;
  • Fluency in English (B2+) - Mandatory ;
  • Willing to move to Portugal with our support.


What do we have to offer you?

  • Comprehensive health insurance, including dental coverage;
  • Feedback&Coffee – our integrated performance management system, with regular feedback sessions and a structured Career Progression Model;
  • Aubay Training Academy, designed for your development: technical and behavioural training (in-class and e-learning), Meet&Techs, Webinars, Mentoring and Technology Centers;
  • Events and team building activities that strengthen team spirit and promote closeness;
  • Digital platform for mental health and emotional well-being, with free psychology consultations, so you can take care of yourself at any time;
  • Health and well-being programme, with workshops and initiatives for our employees and other activities open to the community;
  • We grow with you and your family - we offer a Mini-Aubilous Kit when your children are born and annual support for school supplies, from pre-school to higher education;
  • Language platform, with conversation classes in 12 languages.


What makes us different?

  • Our organisational culture is based on solid values: commitment, excellence, team spirit, well-being, happiness and empathy;
  • We value and recognise those who are part of our history, with referral awards and a special birthday gift;
  • We believe in authenticity: we don't have a dress code, because what matters is talent and attitude;
  • We promote closeness and an informal environment;
  • Here, you will grow in good company, because we believe that professional development also means sharing experiences and building relationships.


Your next adventure starts here!

If you can see yourself growing with us, take the first step and send your CV.

The future is waiting for you — and so are we!

title: Analista de Suporte (Pl)
description:
Somos protagonistas na transformação digital dos meios de pagamento, somos a HST!

Desvendamos os desafios mais complexos e desde a nossa fundação temos a missão de tornar as transações eletrônicas mais seguras.

Estamos presentes em +20 Países e, dentre os nossos Clientes, estão os 8 Bancos mais importantes do Brasil e os 20 da América Latina!


São +80.000 terminais de autoatendimento; +1.000.000 autenticações de transações de compras eletrônicas ao mês; +800.000 cartões bancários com chip disponibilizados ao mês em lojas e agências bancárias; e até em 2024, foram +100 bancos utilizando nossos sistemas de emissor que permitem a tokenização de cartões COF (Card on File) e eCommerce. Isso é só uma parte dos nossos resultados, mas também é só começo!

Nos bastidores de todas as nossas conquistas está o nosso Time, que conta com +200 Pessoas envolvidas no desenvolvimento das nossas soluções. Pessoas questionadoras, curiosas, criativas, proativas, colaborativas e abertas a novas experiências!


Para saber mais sobre a HST e sobre as nossas oportunidades, acesse:


Buscamos uma pessoa Analista de Operações – Suporte (Pleno) para se unir ao nosso Time de Operations para:

  • Criação, revisão e manutenção de materiais de treinamento e documentação técnica, garantindo padronização e atualização contínua;
  • Atendimentos a tickets de clientes nacionais e internacionais, atuando de forma autônoma na análise e resolução de incidentes;
  • Monitoramento de ambientes através do Zabbix e Grafana, realizando análises proativas e acionamentos preventivos quando necessário;
  • Condução de chamadas com clientes nacionais e internacionais para troubleshooting de tickets, realizando alinhamento técnico e definição de próximos passos;
  • Condução ou participação de reuniões de treinamento e/ou alinhamento da solução com clientes, fabricantes e parceiros, conforme a complexidade do tema;
  • Realizar análise, priorizar e abrir demandas técnicas para os times internos, acompanhando a evolução e garantindo retorno adequado ao cliente;
  • Realizar a instalação da solução e executar atualizações em ambientes de homologação e produção, seguindo procedimentos definidos e garantindo a estabilidade dos serviços;
  • Registrar, atualizar e acompanhar tickets, garantindo histórico técnico detalhado, comunicação adequada e cumprimento dos SLAs, mantendo o cliente informado sobre status, próximos passos e orientações;
  • Atuar em escalas de suporte estendido (24x7), incluindo atendimentos em finais de semana.


Acreditamos ser importante que você já tenha passado por algumas experiências e que também tenha os seguintes conhecimentos:

  • Experiência de pelo menos 2 anos atuando em sistemas operacionais Windows e Linux, com capacidade de análise;
  • Experiência em troubleshooting e análise de logs para diagnóstico e resolução de incidentes;
  • Experiência na área de softwares, atuando em configuração, manutenção e condução de treinamentos técnicos para clientes;
  • Experiência consolidada em suporte/operações no atendimento a clientes externos, nacionais ou internacionais;
  • Experiência ou vivência com ferramentas de monitoração de ambientes e serviços;
  • Experiência em atuação em ambientes produtivos, com foco em estabilidade, análise de impacto e mitigação de riscos;
  • Conhecimentos intermediários em redes e protocolos de segurança;
  • Disponibilidade para atuar em suporte estendido (24x7), incluindo escalas aos finais de semana.


Será um grande diferencial se:

  • Conhecimento básico ou contato prévio com Docker, Ansible, Apache e Kong;
  • Espanhol e/ou Inglês em nível básico a intermediário;
  • Conhecimentos básicos de Scrum;
  • Conhecimento ou vivência em monitoração de serviços;
  • Vivência em atividades rotineiras de suporte, como acompanhamento, execução e atualização de tickets de atendimento;
  • Noções de comunicação com o cliente e acompanhamento de indicadores de atendimento (ex.: SLA, FCR, tempo de resposta, entre outros);
  • Conhecimento com produtos ou com conceitos relacionados a meios de pagamento.


O que oferecemos?

A HST é uma empresa certificada GPTW! Oferecemos a oportunidade de crescimento em um ambiente de desafios em que a contrapartida de cada Pessoa equivale ao tamanho da sua vontade de crescer !

  • Contratação em regime CLT;
  • Atuação 100% Remota;
  • Horário flexível;
  • Oportunidade de crescimento, através do contínuo desenvolvimento, tanto técnico quanto pessoal;
  • Temos programas de desenvolvimento destinado às novas lideranças;
  • 10% das horas mensais, podem ser dedicadas para aprender algo novo;
  • Day-Off no mês do aniversário;
  • Ajuda de Custo Home Office;
  • Licença Maternidade e Paternidade Ampliadas;
  • Participação nos Lucros e Resultados;
  • WellHub (antiga Gympass);
  • Convênio médico;
  • Convênio odontológico;
  • Vale Alimentação/Refeição;
  • Vale Transporte ou estacionamento;
  • Auxílio Creche;
  • Seguro de Vida.


Prezamos por um bom ambiente de trabalho que contribua para as pessoas evoluírem e se sentirem acolhidas, livres, autênticas e à vontade para demonstrarem suas habilidades! Apoiamos a diversidade e não temos espaço para qualquer tipo de discriminação!
